caseNameFull: Hofflund v. Seaton, Secretary of the Interior
attorneys: Petitioner pro se. Solicitor General Rankin, Assistant Attorney General Doub- and Samuel D. Slade for respondents.

opinions.text: Motion to substitute Roger W. Jones as a party respondent in the place of Harry Ellsworth granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit denied.
